prompt: Write a one-page e-commerce strategy for {brand_name} selling {niche} to {audience}. Include: target customer segments, 3 business goals (6-12 months), KPIs, pricing strategy, fulfillment options, 3 launch channels, and a 90-day roadmap.
Create a product mix recommendation for {niche}: core product, 3 accessories, 2 subscription options, 3 premium bundles. Show suggested retail price ranges in {currency}.
Create a brand voice guide for {brand_name}: 6 adjectives, dos/don'ts, 8 microcopy examples for product pages, and 5 email subject line examples in a {tone} voice.
Generate a homepage wireframe outline for an e-commerce store selling {niche}. Include above-the-fold content, hero copy, primary CTA, featured collections, customer trust elements, and footer links.
List 12 accessibility checklist items for an e-commerce site and short remediation notes for each (ARIA, keyboard nav, forms, labels).

Write a product page for {product_name} for {brand_name} ({niche}). Include: short tagline (10-12 words); 3 bullet benefits aimed at {audience}; detailed description (120-180 words); 5 SEO keywords; 3 social captions.
Write a category page for {collection_name}: intro paragraph (100 words), three subcategories, buyer guide (4 tips), and links to 4 top products.
Create an SEO blog outline + intro (200 words) titled '{topic}' relevant to {niche}. List 8 subheadings, suggested CTAs, and 5 long-tail keywords.
Produce SEO meta title, meta description, H1, and 5 long-tail keywords for product {product_name} aimed at {country} buyers.
Create JSON-LD structured data snippet for product {product_name} including price {price}, currency {currency}, availability, and placeholder aggregateRating.
Write 10 Google responsive search ad headlines and 4 descriptions for {brand_name} selling {niche}, optimized for conversions and including {USP}.
Create 6 Facebook/Instagram ad captions and 3 image suggestions for a best-seller in {niche}. Provide 3 A/B test variants (price, scarcity, social proof).
Design a 5-email welcome flow for new subscribers: goals, subject lines, short body copy, send timing, and CTA per email (include abandoned cart variant).
Write 3 cross-sell snippets and 3 up-sell lines for product pages; include where to place them and one-liner cart pop-up messages.
List best checkout UX patterns to reduce friction for {audience}, including guest checkout, express payments, one-page flows, and required fields.
Generate checkout microcopy for shipping estimator, coupon field, order summary, and security reassurance to reduce abandonment.

Recommend a tech stack for {brand_name} selling {niche} with expected monthly traffic {visitors}: CMS, front end, headless options, payments, analytics, search, email, and sample monthly cost estimates.
Provide a step-by-step integration plan for connecting {platform} to a fulfillment API and SMS provider including webhook test cases.

Generate a Next.js + Tailwind starter e-commerce scaffold for {niche} with pages: index, product/[slug], category/[slug], cart, checkout skeleton. Include API route examples for cart and a mock product JSON schema.
Produce a minimal Shopify theme liquid template for product.liquid with sections for images, price, badges, and related products snippet.
Write a unit test plan and sample tests (Jest/React Testing Library) for cart functionality: add, remove, quantity update, and persisted state.
Audit checklist prompt: produce a prioritized performance audit list (Lighthouse) for an e-commerce site and short fixes for each item (image formats, CDN, caching).
List security hardening steps for an e-commerce site (payment PCI considerations, CSP, rate limits, dependency scans).
Create an analytics tracking plan: events for view_item, add_to_cart, checkout_start, purchase. Provide GTM trigger names and recommended dashboards.
Write an SQL query (Postgres) to compute repeat purchase rate by cohort over 6 months from orders (id,user_id,total,created_at).
Propose 6 A/B tests to raise add-to-cart rate for {brand_name}, each with hypothesis, audience, metric, and sample variation copy/design.
Draft a fulfillment SOP for {brand_name}: receiving, packing, shipping, returns, RMA, 6 key SLAs, and templates for customer status alerts.
Make a 30-day launch checklist: pre-launch QA, list of assets, influencer outreach template, and 5 launch KPIs.
Write a set of 20 FAQ Q&A pairs for support chatbot covering shipping, returns, sizing, payments, and delays.
Create a conversation tree for a chatbot to handle product recommendations: ask 3 qualifying questions and recommend 3 SKUs with links.
Translate and adapt product page copy into {language} keeping brand tone {tone}, and adapt pricing display and shipping notes.
Produce an accessibility audit prompt to check e-commerce forms, keyboard navigation, alt text, color contrast, and ARIA roles with remediation steps.
Generate a QA checklist for release: smoke tests for checkout, product pages, search, payment providers, order emails, and analytics events.
Create 10 Cypress test cases for checkout flow (product selection to order confirmation).

Create a complete e-commerce site plan for {brand_name} selling pet supplies to busy pet owners: homepage hero copy, 3 product pages (title + 100-150 word descriptions), 3 blog topics + intros, 5 SEO keywords, 3 ad captions, suggested pricing tiers.
Create a complete e-commerce site plan for {brand_name} selling smart home essentials for pet safety/automation: hero, 3 product pages, 3 blog topics, 5 keywords, 3 ads, pricing tiers.
Create a complete e-commerce site plan for {brand_name} selling Baby & kids items to new parents: hero, 3 product pages, safety copy notes, blog topics, keywords, ads, pricing tiers.
Create a complete e-commerce site plan for {brand_name} selling travel accessories to frequent travelers: hero, 3 product pages, packing tips blog topics, keywords, ads, pricing.
Create a complete e-commerce site plan for {brand_name} selling eco/sustainable products: mission-led copy, 3 product pages, sustainability claims, blog topics, keywords, ads.
Create a complete e-commerce site plan for {brand_name} selling fashion/apparel: hero, 3 product pages, fit guide, blog topics, keywords, ad captions, pricing tiers.
Produce SEO meta title, description, H1 and 5 keywords for 'AutoFeed Pro' smart feeder aimed at US pet owners.
Write 6 social ad captions for NexCart's 'AutoFeed Pro' focusing on convenience, safety, and subscription refill services. Include 3 visual direction notes.
Write an abandoned cart email for {brand_name} that recovers 10-15% of carts: subject line, 50-80 word body, urgency line, CTA.
Write a friendly returns and refund policy for {brand_name} in {country} (80-120 words).
Draft an empathetic support reply for delayed shipping for {brand_name}, including compensation options and next steps to resolve.
Create three bundle offers for pet owners combining a smart feeder, camera, and subscription for consumables. Provide names and short copy for each bundle.
Generate 12 social post ideas for the next 30 days promoting new arrivals, reviews, behind-the-scenes, user-generated content, and sustainability stories.
Rewrite these button labels for accessibility: 'Buy', 'Add', 'Checkout' into clearer calls to action and include aria-label suggestions.
List top 8 quick wins to improve Lighthouse performance by 20% on an e-commerce homepage and short implementation notes.
Write 6 trust badges/messages to place near price and CTA that reduce purchase anxiety (shipping, returns, secure payment, warranty).
